note: Madison County MT publishes no county zoning ordinance or zoning districts layer; its planning office lists only subdivision regulations, growth policy and airport rules. The only zoning found is the Town of Ennis official zoning map, published as a static PDF (no GIS service). Ennis's 2018 draft ordinance called for a GIS-built map but no service was found. Twin Bridges, Virginia City and Sheridan publish no zoning found. ArcGIS searches for Madison County zoning returned only parcels, boundaries and other non-zoning layers.
